summary:
Out-of-bounds write of one or two bytes when the printf builtin (and
echo %b) converts a \u or \U Unicode escape into a multi-byte sequence.

dash 0.5.12 has no \u or \U escapes. conv_escape() in src/bltin/printf.c
handles only \\ \a \b \f \n \r \t \v and octal escapes; Debian's patch
0008-Support-e-in-echo-and-printf-builtins adds \e and nothing else. The
Unicode-escape conversion arrived with upstream's "dollar single quote"
work and was first released in dash 0.5.13. Trixie ships 0.5.12-12.

MUST re-evaluate if trixie moves dash to 0.5.13 or later.
